# shikshamagic-ui — LLM & AI Assistant Context Manifest
> This file is optimized for consumption by Large Language Models (LLMs), AI coding agents (Cursor, Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Devin) to generate valid, bug-free React code with `shikshamagic-ui`.

## Package Identity
- Package Name: `shikshamagic-ui`
- Description: Enterprise-grade, animation-powered React UI library & design system for EdTech, creators, and modern web apps.
- Imports: All components are exported from the package root:
  `import { ThemeProvider, Button, Input, Card, Modal, Table, ... } from 'shikshamagic-ui';`

## Mandatory Rule
Always wrap your application or component tree with `<ThemeProvider>`:
```tsx
import { ThemeProvider } from 'shikshamagic-ui';

<ThemeProvider>
  <YourComponents />
</ThemeProvider>
```

---

## Component Reference & Types

### 1. Button
- Export: `Button`
- Props:
  - `variant`: `'primary' | 'secondary' | 'success' | 'error' | 'warning' | 'info'` (default: `'primary'`)
  - `type`: `'solid' | 'outline' | 'ghost' | 'flat'` (default: `'solid'`)
  - `size`: `'2xs' | 'xs' | 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'` (default: `'md'`)
  - `disabled`: `boolean`
  - `loading`: `boolean`
  - `icon`: `IconName` (string name of icon from `shikshamagic-ui`)
  - `iconPosition`: `'start' | 'end'`
  - `action`: `'button' | 'submit' | 'reset'`
  - `children`: `React.ReactNode`
- Example:
  `<Button variant="primary" type="solid" loading={false}>Submit Course</Button>`

### 2. IconButton
- Export: `IconButton`
- Props:
  - `icon`: `IconName` (e.g. `'search_line'`, `'notification_line'`, `'add_line'`, `'delete_line'`, `'edit_line'`, `'settings_line'`)
  - `variant`: `'primary' | 'secondary' | 'success' | 'error' | 'warning' | 'info'`
  - `size`: `'2xs' | 'xs' | 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'`
  - `onClick`: `() => void`
- Example:
  `<IconButton icon="search_line" variant="primary" onClick={handleSearch} />`

### 3. Input & PhoneInput
- Export: `Input`, `PhoneInput`
- `Input` Props:
  - `label`: `string`
  - `placeholder`: `string`
  - `value`: `string | number`
  - `defaultValue`: `string | number`
  - `type`: `'text' | 'search' | 'number'`
  - `size`: `'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'`
  - `errorMessage`: `string`
  - `valid`: `boolean`
  - `allowClear`: `boolean`
  - `description`: `string`
  - `leadingIcon`: `React.ReactNode`
  - `trailingIcon`: `React.ReactNode`
  - `onChange`: `(e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => void`
- `PhoneInput` Props:
  - All `Input` props plus:
  - `defaultCountryCode`: `string` (e.g. `'IN'`, `'US'`, `'GB'`)
  - `allowSearch`: `boolean`
  - `onChangeCountryCode`: `(code: string) => void`
- Example:
  `<Input label="Student Email" placeholder="student@example.com" type="text" />`
  `<PhoneInput label="WhatsApp Number" defaultCountryCode="IN" />`

### 4. TextArea
- Export: `TextArea`
- Props:
  - `label`: `string`
  - `placeholder`: `string`
  - `value`: `string`
  - `rows`: `number` (default: 4)
  - `errorMessage`: `string`
  - `onChange`: `(e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => void`
- Example:
  `<TextArea label="Course Description" rows={4} placeholder="Describe this syllabus..." />`

### 5. Card
- Export: `Card`
- Props:
  - `heading`: `React.ReactNode`
  - `subheading`: `React.ReactNode`
  - `children`: `React.ReactNode`
  - `actions`: `React.ReactNode`
- Example:
  ```tsx
  <Card heading="Advanced System Design" subheading="Batch 2026">
    <p>32 Lectures, 14 Assignments completed.</p>
    <Button variant="primary">Resume Lesson</Button>
  </Card>
  ```

### 6. Modal
- Export: `Modal`
- Props:
  - `open`: `boolean`
  - `onClose`: `() => void`
  - `title`: `React.ReactNode`
  - `children`: `React.ReactNode`
- Example:
  ```tsx
  <Modal open={isOpen} onClose={() => setIsOpen(false)} title="Create Batch">
    <div>Modal content here</div>
  </Modal>
  ```

### 7. Drawer
- Export: `Drawer`
- Props:
  - `open`: `boolean`
  - `onClose`: `() => void`
  - `title`: `React.ReactNode`
  - `children`: `React.ReactNode`
- Example:
  ```tsx
  <Drawer open={isDrawerOpen} onClose={() => setIsDrawerOpen(false)} title="Filters">
    <div>Filter by category, price, rating</div>
  </Drawer>
  ```

### 8. Table
- Export: `Table`
- Props:
  - `columns`: `Array<{ key: string, title: string, dataIndex: string }>`
  - `dataSource`: `Array<Record<string, any>>`
  - `loading`: `boolean`
- Example:
  ```tsx
  const cols = [
    { key: 'name', title: 'Course Name', dataIndex: 'name' },
    { key: 'students', title: 'Enrolled', dataIndex: 'students' },
    { key: 'revenue', title: 'Revenue', dataIndex: 'revenue' },
  ];
  const data = [
    { key: '1', name: 'Full Stack AI', students: '1,240', revenue: '₹4,99,000' },
  ];
  <Table columns={cols} dataSource={data} />
  ```

### 9. Alert
- Export: `Alert`
- Props:
  - `title`: `string`
  - `message`: `string`
  - `variant`: `'success' | 'warning' | 'error' | 'info'`
  - `onClose`: `() => void`
- Example:
  `<Alert title="Registration Live" message="Admissions open for summer cohort." variant="success" />`

### 10. Checkbox & Switch & RadioGroup
- Exports: `Checkbox`, `Switch`, `Radio`, `RadioGroup`
- `Checkbox`: `<Checkbox checked={val} onChange={() => setVal(!val)}>Accept terms</Checkbox>`
- `Switch`: `<Switch checked={val} onChange={() => setVal(!val)}>Dark Mode</Switch>`
- `RadioGroup`:
  ```tsx
  <RadioGroup value={val} onChange={setVal}>
    <Radio value="monthly">Monthly Plan</Radio>
    <Radio value="yearly">Annual Plan</Radio>
  </RadioGroup>
  ```

### 11. Tag & Badge & Rating
- `Tag`: `<Tag variant="primary">Featured</Tag>` (`variant="primary" | "secondary" | "success" | "warning" | "error"`)
- `Badge`: `<Badge count={5}><IconButton icon="notification_line" /></Badge>`
- `Rating`: `<Rating value={4.5} count={5} onChange={(val) => setRating(val)} />`

### 12. Avatar & AvatarGroup
- `Avatar`: `<Avatar title="Sachin Yadav" size="md" />`
- `AvatarGroup`: `<AvatarGroup avatars={[{ title: 'A' }, { title: 'B' }]} max={3} />`

### 13. Select
- Export: `Select`
- Props:
  - `options`: `Array<{ label: React.ReactNode, value: any, disabled?: boolean }>`
  - `multiSelect`: `boolean`
  - `allowSearch`: `boolean`
  - `onSelect`: `(selectedValues: any[], selectedOptions: any[]) => void`
- Example:
  ```tsx
  <Select
    options={[
      { label: 'Frontend Engineering', value: 'fe' },
      { label: 'Data Science', value: 'ds' },
    ]}
    onSelect={(val) => console.log(val)}
  />
  ```

### 14. Collapse (Accordion)
- Export: `Collapse`
- Props:
  - `sections`: `Array<{ id: string, title: React.ReactNode, children: React.ReactNode }>`
  - `variant`: `'outlined' | 'ghost' | 'filled'`

### 15. Toast & Toaster
- Export: `toast`, `Toaster`
- Usage:
  1. Mount `<Toaster />` once near your root.
  2. Call `toast.success('Course created successfully!')` or `toast.error('Failed to save.')`.

---

## Icon Reference
Over 2,800 icons available in `<Icon name="icon_name" size={20} />` and `<IconButton icon="icon_name" />`. Common ones:
- `search_line`, `search_fill`
- `add_line`, `add_circle_line`
- `close_line`, `close_circle_line`
- `check_line`, `check_circle_line`
- `arrow_right_line`, `arrow_left_line`, `arrow_down_line`, `arrow_up_line`
- `notification_line`, `notification_fill`
- `user_line`, `contacts_line`
- `calendar_line`, `time_line`
- `settings_line`, `edit_line`, `delete_line`
- `download_line`, `upload_line`
- `eye_line`, `eye_off_line`
